title: PipeshubToolResultPresentedEvent
description: How a tool result is shown: status, the bounded preview and a summary. Presentation only (non-critical).

content.description: The bounded result preview (TOOL_CALL_RESULT content, parts resultPreview).

savedContent.description: The preview as parts[] keep it (resultPreview), when that differs from content: this request's citation refs stored as the URLs they stand for, within the same bound.

savedSummary.description: The summary as parts[] keep it, when that differs from resultSummary: citation refs stored as URLs.

resultView.description: The tool's small view of the full result (a table or a record's fields, Tool.result_view), within the run's view budget: TOOL_CALL_RESULT resultView, parts resultView.

step.description: Which page, query, pattern or file the step used, and what came of it (WP-115): the loop's steps carry the facts an engine's do.

limits.description: R32REPO-FU-1: what a job's step met and could not do (a code_task's clones that did not happen), from the job's journal: the parent's answer leads with them.
